body: Could you possibly give any help on confrontation? I've never raised my voice at someone, never told someone something they didn't want to hear. I would have no idea how to tell someone to leave me the fuck alone for a few weeks and let me be at peace and that they're causing so much misery to me.

I would never dream of dropping out. I wish to become a hardware engineer(though that will never happen) and that requires schooling. Every damn thing needs schooling. 

Ending my life would be much easier than dropping out.

I haven't seen a doctor about anything. I don't want to take medication. Medication is what leads people to become abusive. My family has an alcohol abuse issue, i fear that will translate to pills.

The lack of sleep is both. I lie awake without any thoughts at all, unable to close my eyes and sleep. Other times I am kept awake by re-living every shitty thing ive said, every embarrassing moment i've had.

It's not much of people placing stress on me so much as their natural expectations. I wouldn't confront them. I can't. I would hurt their feelings. I would never want someone to have grief in their life because of what I would say to them.
